requirements.requirement: The system must retrieve PI credibility data from the backend response payload via evaluate_care_facade before rendering the trial scorecard.
The system must bind the backend PI data fields to the frontend schema defined in EVAL-CT-PI-UX-S1 without transformation errors.
The system must render PI credibility data when a complete payload (all expected fields present) is returned.
The system must safely render partial PI data when one or more non-critical fields are missing without causing UI failure.
The system must display a fallback message when PI data is null or absent in the backend response.
The system must not render the PI credibility component when the PI data object is undefined or empty.
The system must handle backend API errors (e.g., 4xx/5xx) by displaying a non-blocking fallback state for PI credibility.
The system must ensure that PI data binding does not break or delay rendering of other trial scorecard components.
The system must validate the PI data payload structure against the defined schema before attempting to render.
The system must log an error event when PI data is missing, malformed, or fails schema validation.
The system must prevent runtime crashes caused by null or undefined PI data references during rendering.
The system must display default placeholder values for optional PI fields when they are missing but the object exists.
